en.app.title: LocaleLens Demo
en.home.title: Welcome
en.home.description: This demo shows how LocaleLens replaces file-based i18n with a simple API fetch.
en.home.step_1: Translations are fetched from LocaleLens at request time
en.home.step_2: Next.js caches the response for 60 seconds
en.home.step_3: No JSON files, no framework, just fetch()
en.home.missing_key_description: When a key doesn't exist, the key itself is returned:
en.about.title: About This Demo
en.about.description: This is a minimal i18n implementation for Next.js using LocaleLens.
en.about.no_framework_detail: No next-intl, no next-i18next. Just a simple getTranslations() function.
en.about.server_first_detail: Translations are fetched in server components. No client-side state.
en.about.cache_friendly_detail: Next.js fetch revalidation handles caching automatically.

de.about.description: Eine minimale i18n-Implementierung für Next.js mit LocaleLens.
